text: Based on the output from the NASA FIRMS dataset, there were no fire detections intersecting with the asset ASSET-F02 during the period from September 25, 2026, to October 25, 2026. The sensors VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, and MODIS covered the asset for most of the period, with the exception of the last day, which was not covered due to the latest NRT file update. Therefore, it can be concluded that there was no fire on the asset during the evaluated period.
